description: Calculate حق‌التحریر (the notary office's fee) from the official 1405 tariff for دفاتر اسناد رسمی. Distinct from حق‌الثبت (use calculate_stamp_duty for that). Never estimate the tariff.

amount_toman.description: Document amount in Toman (rate-based types only; for real estate this is ارزش معاملاتی, not market price).

doc_type.description: Document type. Rate-based types (need amount_toman): immovable/sale, movable/vehicle, financial/mortgage/partnership, lease. Others are fixed-fee.

obligor_count.description: Number of obligors (optional; each beyond two adds a surcharge).

name: calculate_notary_fee
title: محاسبهٔ حق‌التحریر دفترخانه — Calculate notary fee
